title: BetaResponseConfigurationUpdate
description:
A configuration update for subsequent responses. Each setting stays in effect
until a later update replaces that setting.

agent.description: The agent that produced this item.

id.description: The unique ID of the configuration update item.

reasoning.description: The reasoning configuration applied by this update.

effort.description:
The reasoning effort used for subsequent responses until another
configuration update replaces it.

text.description: The text output configuration for subsequent responses.

format.description: Use a JSON schema for structured output or text to return to plain text.
